# Generated by asn1c-r18 with -fprefix=ASN_XNAP_ -fcommon, so this directory
# holds nothing but generated code: the skeleton runtime lives once in
# src/asn/asn1c and these headers reach it by relative path ("../asn1c/...").
# Do not add skeleton files here -- a second copy shadows the shared runtime
# for this library only, which is how the pre-Release-18 tree ended up writing
# descriptors with one struct layout and reading them with another.
file(GLOB HDR_FILES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ASN_XNAP_*.h)
file(GLOB SRC_FILES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ASN_XNAP_*.c)

add_library(asn-xnap ${HDR_FILES} ${SRC_FILES})
target_include_directories(asn-xnap PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(asn-xnap asn-asn1c)
